Article 10 — Dividends

2. The tax charged in the State of the company paying the dividends shall not exceed: (a) 10 per cent of the gross amount if the recipient is a company owning at least 25 per cent of the voting shares for the six months immediately preceding payment; (b) 15 per cent of the gross amount in all other cases.

Article 11 — Interest

2. Source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest. 3. Interest derived by the Government of the other Contracting State, including local authorities, the Central Bank or a wholly government-owned financial institution, or by a resident with respect to debt-claims guaranteed or indirectly financed by such bodies, shall be exempt from tax in the source State.

Article 12 — Royalties

2(a) Industrial royalties may be taxed in the source State, but the tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount. 2(b) Cultural royalties shall be exempt from taxes in the source State. Paragraph 3 defines industrial royalties as patents, trade marks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, equipment and industrial, commercial or scientific experience; cultural royalties cover copyright of literary, artistic or scientific works, including cinematograph films and films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting.
